immutable_boundaries.action_limits: finite action with scenario shape, norm cap, and final bounds clipping
forbidden_changes: Do not modify frozen scenario or evaluator files.
Do not consume global simulator state or training-only privileged state.
Do not replace the explicit rule method with a learned method during this search stage.
immutable_boundaries.information_limits: scenario observation contract only; graph/image policies use declared proprioception
method_invariants: Execute with local scenario observations and non-privileged info only.
Clip every final action to scenario.action_space.

execution_information: progress, normalized time, message age, and role code when declared
method.name: role_aware_pursuit_rule

reward_design.intent: No training reward is used by this frozen rule baseline.

method.selection_rationale: A bounded observation-only rule controller is the smallest executable reference for protocol and promotion testing; it is not claimed to be the final high-performance method.

optimization_guidance: Tune gain and damping before action_cap.
For adversarial or communication tasks, tune role/communication parameters only after safety passes.
Use scenario evaluation metrics for promotion; never substitute training reward.
method_hypothesis.statement: For S13, role_aware_pursuit_rule should improve team_capture_rate over the explicit zero-action baseline without action, collision, or boundary violations.
suspected_bottlenecks: gain/damping trade-off under scenario hard constraints
